messages:
marta: FYI onboarding hit: our quickstart (README + sample app) demonstrates `max_output_tokens` and `stop_sequences`, but the Go SDK only accepts `MaxTokens` and `Stop`. customers copy/paste the sample, see no-op stop behavior, and open tickets. also noticed SDK default temperature=0.8, quickstart claims 1.0. messy.

kevin: ugh. i've seen 2 support tickets this week about truncated responses and missing stop sequences. can repro with curl vs go sdk. curl honors `Retry-After` on 429, our go sdk ignores it and retries immediately.

marta: repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"test","max_output_tokens":20,"stop_sequences":["<STOP>"]}'
```

marta: repro (go sdk):
```
client.Generate(ctx, GenerateParams{Model: "gpt-mini", Input: "test", MaxOutputTokens: 20, StopSequences: []string{"<STOP>"}})
// currently gets dropped and behaves as if no stop provided
```

ryan-sdk: thanks for the clear repro. root cause: parameter mapping layer in go-sdk was implemented during early v1 rollout and we used different camelcase names (`MaxTokens` vs `MaxOutputTokens`) in the struct tags. i didn't add flexible unmarshalling for legacy names. the retry middleware also predates Retry-After semantics. i'll do a small fix:
- accept both names in incoming param structs and map to the server fields
- pass through stop_sequences verbatim to the http body
- update retry middleware to respect a Retry-After header (sleep that many seconds when present)

kevin: can you backport to the 0.6.x maintenance branch? a Dedicated customer is blocked on onboarding.

ryan-sdk: yes. will open PRs: main + backport to release/0.6.x. i'll include unit tests for param aliasing and an integration test using the mock server responding 429 + Retry-After.

docs: please update the quickstart and sample-app README to use the canonical param names we expose and note the aliases. also adjust the temperature default in the snippets to match SDK 0.8 default (or change SDK default in the PR and call it out).

marta: small ask: add a short migration snippet in the sample-app README:
```
// if you were using max_output_tokens in REST, in Go SDK use MaxTokens or upgrade to SDK >=0.7.2
```

deploy-bot: pre-release: go-sdk 0.7.2-rc1 built. CI: 85 passed, 2 flaky (mock-server timing). staging deploy scheduled.

ryan-sdk: PRs opened: #482 (param aliases + Retry-After handling) targeting main and release/0.6.x. #483 updates sample app + quickstart. tagging @docs and @kevin for review.

marta: thanks all. i'll ping customer success with a short workaround to use curl until the backport lands. :white_check_mark:
